Task Description:
Your task is to create a file /app/src/program.cbl in which there will be a new COBOL program in fixed format, 
which will be run from the /app/src directory and should be compiled and executed using GnuCOBOL 3.  
Do not include ">>SOURCE FORMAT IS FIXED". Keep each line ≤ 80 characters. The compiler will use fixed format by default.
The program will run from /app/src directory and must compile with GnuCOBOL 3. File /app/src/INPUT.DAT already exist.
  Processes mortgage applications. Checks terms and generates a payment schedule. The program reads the existing file at /app/src/INPUT.DAT.
  ID - X(10) NAME - X(30) LOAN-AMOUNT - 9(10) PROPERTY-VALUE - 9(10) DOWN-PAYMENT - 9(10) TERM - 9(2) RATE - 9(3)V9(2) separated by the symbol ';'.
  Calculates the minimum down payment (15% of the property value). If the client's down payment is less, the application is rejected.
  For approved applications, the monthly payment is calculated using the annuity nominal formula and a full payment schedule is generated.
  The results are written to the file at /app/data/OUTPUT.DAT: ID - X(10) STATUS - X(5) (REASON - X(50) in case of refusal)
    For rejected applications: ID and reason for rejection.
    For approved applications: ID and  «APPRO\n» and detailed payment schedule:
    MON-NUMBER - 9(3) PAYMENT-AMOUNT, INTEREST-PART, PRINCIPAL-PART - 9(8).99 REMAINING-BALANCE - 9(10).99.(without header).
    - CALCULATIONS: 
        MIN_DOWN = PROP_VALUE * 0.15
        MONTHLY_RATE = INTEREST_RATE / 1200
        MONTHLY_PAYMENT = LOAN_AMOUNT * monthly_rate / (1 - (1 + monthly_rate)**(-term_months))
        Use ROUNDED for all financial computations.
  Success Criteria:
    A correctly constructed payment schedule in the file output. Example output file:
     «TEST000001DENY INSUFFICIENT FUNDS FOR DOWN PAYMENT
      TEST000002APPRO
      001 00000400.00 00000022.92 00000377.08 0000004622.92 etc.»

       PROGRAM-ID. PROGRAM.

       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO "INPUT.DAT"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       01  IN-REC                      PIC X(200).
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       01  OUT-REC                     PIC X(200).

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF                      PIC X VALUE "N".

       01  WS-FIELDS.
           05  WS-ID                   PIC X(10).
           05  WS-NAME                 PIC X(30).
           05  WS-LOAN-TXT             PIC X(20).
           05  WS-PROP-TXT             PIC X(20).
           05  WS-DOWN-TXT             PIC X(20).
           05  WS-TERM-TXT             PIC X(10).
           05  WS-RATE-TXT             PIC X(20).

       01  WS-NUMERIC.
           05  WS-LOAN                 PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-PROP                 PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-DOWN                 PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-MIN-DOWN             PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-RATE                 COMP-2.
           05  WS-MONTH-RATE           COMP-2.
           05  WS-TERM-YEARS           PIC 9(3) COMP-3.
           05  WS-TERM-MONTHS          PIC 9(4) COMP-3.
           05  WS-PAYMENT              PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-INTEREST             PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-PRINCIPAL            PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-BALANCE              PIC 9(12)V99 COMP-3.
           05  WS-DENOM                COMP-2.
           05  WS-POWER                COMP-2.

       01  WS-EDIT.
           05  E-MON                   PIC 9(3).
           05  E-PAY                   PIC 9(8).99.
           05  E-INT                   PIC 9(8).99.
           05  E-PRN                   PIC 9(8).99.
           05  E-BAL                   PIC 9(10).99.

       01  WS-I                        PIC 9(4) COMP-3.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF = "Y"
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END
                       MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF
                   NOT AT END
                       PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           STOP RUN.

       PROCESS-REC.
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-FIELDS
           UNSTRING IN-REC DELIMITED BY ";"
               INTO WS-ID
                    WS-NAME
                    WS-LOAN-TXT
                    WS-PROP-TXT
                    WS-DOWN-TXT
                    WS-TERM-TXT
                    WS-RATE-TXT
           END-UNSTRING

           MOVE FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-LOAN-TXT) TO WS-LOAN
           MOVE FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-PROP-TXT) TO WS-PROP
           MOVE FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-DOWN-TXT) TO WS-DOWN
           MOVE FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-TERM-TXT) TO WS-TERM-YEARS
           MOVE FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-RATE-TXT) TO WS-RATE

           COMPUTE WS-MIN-DOWN ROUNDED = WS-PROP * 0.15

           IF WS-DOWN < WS-MIN-DOWN
               PERFORM WRITE-DENY
           ELSE
               PERFORM WRITE-APPROVE
               PERFORM BUILD-SCHEDULE
           END-IF.

       WRITE-DENY.
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-REC
           STRING WS-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  "DENY " DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  "INSUFFICIENT FUNDS FOR DOWN PAYMENT"
                    DELIMITED BY SIZE
             INTO OUT-REC
           END-STRING
           WRITE OUT-REC.

       WRITE-APPROVE.
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-REC
           STRING WS-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  "APPRO" DELIMITED BY SIZE
             INTO OUT-REC
           END-STRING
           WRITE OUT-REC.

       BUILD-SCHEDULE.
           COMPUTE WS-TERM-MONTHS ROUNDED = WS-TERM-YEARS * 12
           COMPUTE WS-MONTH-RATE = WS-RATE / 1200.0
           MOVE WS-LOAN TO WS-BALANCE

           IF WS-TERM-MONTHS = 0
               EXIT PARAGRAPH
           END-IF

           IF WS-MONTH-RATE = 0
               COMPUTE WS-PAYMENT ROUNDED = WS-LOAN / WS-TERM-MONTHS
           ELSE
               COMPUTE WS-POWER = (1.0 + WS-MONTH-RATE)
                   ** (-WS-TERM-MONTHS)
               COMPUTE WS-DENOM = 1.0 - WS-POWER
               COMPUTE WS-PAYMENT ROUNDED =
                   WS-LOAN * WS-MONTH-RATE / WS-DENOM
           END-IF

           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-I > WS-TERM-MONTHS
               COMPUTE WS-INTEREST ROUNDED =
                   WS-BALANCE * WS-MONTH-RATE
               IF WS-I = WS-TERM-MONTHS
                   MOVE WS-BALANCE TO WS-PRINCIPAL
                   COMPUTE WS-PAYMENT ROUNDED =
                       WS-PRINCIPAL + WS-INTEREST
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-BALANCE
               ELSE
                   COMPUTE WS-PRINCIPAL ROUNDED =
                       WS-PAYMENT - WS-INTEREST
                   COMPUTE WS-BALANCE ROUNDED =
                       WS-BALANCE - WS-PRINCIPAL
               END-IF
               PERFORM WRITE-SCHED-LINE
           END-PERFORM.

       WRITE-SCHED-LINE.
           MOVE WS-I TO E-MON
           MOVE WS-PAYMENT TO E-PAY
           MOVE WS-INTEREST TO E-INT
           MOVE WS-PRINCIPAL TO E-PRN
           MOVE WS-BALANCE TO E-BAL

           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-REC
           STRING E-MON DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  SPACE
                  E-PAY DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  SPACE
                  E-INT DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  SPACE
                  E-PRN DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  SPACE
                  E-BAL DELIMITED BY SIZE
             INTO OUT-REC
           END-STRING
           WRITE OUT-REC.
COBOL
